author: Cxnfirmed
body:
Gonna try to make an appeal for the third time, you guys apparently need over 2 months to "review" my ban.

Username: Cxnfirmed (xTrinn)

Banned for: Ghost client (triggerbot and reach)

Why should I be unbanned: Because you have no evidence, and the ban is completely false.


  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? Yes.
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? Yes. Tell me how you managed to figure out it was a ghost client and it's fine. But you can't, so there is your evidence.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? Yes.
  • Have I been caught ban evading? No.
  • Have I appealed a ban before? Yes.

None of your videos proves anything, and you simply can't tell if I am using a ghost client by judging off a 3rd person video. And when you can't prove that I am using a ghost client, how can you prove that I am using triggerbot and reach? Like, give me a detailed explanation on how you simply can detect triggerbot and ghost client judging off a 20 fps 3rd person video? It's impossible.
